display_title: I Drank It Instead of My Husband
description:
A young woman who has loved her guardian knight since childhood enters a political marriage with him, only to find their relationship colder and more distant than she ever imagined. In desperation, she prepares a love potion to save what little hope remains just as he unexpectedly demands a divorce. When a misunderstanding escalates and fate intervenes, a single night pushes their failing marriage into dangerous new territory, forcing both to confront feelings they have long tried to deny.
